zh: 随着互联网的发展，越来越多的人选择在线学习。
ref: With the development of the Internet, more and more people choose to study online.
tip: 「随着……」用 with + 名词短语；「越来越多」more and more。

zh: 这道题太难了，我花了半个小时才做出来。
ref: The problem was so difficult that it took me half an hour to work it out.
tip: 「花时间做某事」用 it takes sb. some time to do sth.。

zh: 他不仅会说英语，还会说法语。
ref: He can speak not only English but also French.
tip: not only ... but also ... 连接并列成分，注意结构对称。

zh: 我们应该重视环境保护，否则后果不堪设想。
ref: We should attach importance to environmental protection; otherwise, the consequences would be too terrible to imagine.
tip: 「重视」attach importance to；「不堪设想」beyond imagination / too terrible to imagine。

zh: 昨天我见到的那个人是我以前的老师。
ref: The person I met yesterday was my former teacher.
tip: 定语从句省略关系代词：the person (that) I met。

zh: 如果没有你的帮助，我不可能按时完成这项工作。
ref: Without your help, I could not have finished the work on time.
tip: 对过去的虚拟：could not have done。

zh: 中国有许多名胜古迹，每年吸引大量游客。
ref: China has many places of interest, which attract a large number of tourists every year.
tip: 非限制性定语从句用 which，逗号不能丢。

zh: 他习惯于每天早上跑步，这使他保持健康。
ref: He is used to running every morning, which keeps him healthy.
tip: be used to doing 表示「习惯于」；which 指代前面整句。

zh: 我们应该学会独立思考，而不是盲目跟随别人。
ref: We should learn to think independently instead of following others blindly.

zh: 这本书值得一读，它对我们了解历史很有帮助。
ref: The book is worth reading; it is very helpful for us to understand history.
tip: be worth doing，主动形式表被动意义。
